item.text: The FASTQ is a valid 13.5 MB single-end Sanger-quality dataset already staged in the supplied history. The available broad reference is Kraken2’s current RefSeq core nucleotide database, so I’m running it with an aggregate report and default sensitivity to identify human reads and any consistently supported non-human clade.

Kraken2 completed successfully against the broad core nucleotide reference, but Galaxy’s run record shows the report selector was not applied (it resolved to the default “no”), leaving only one output dataset. I’m inspecting that terminal output and the tool’s conditional-input encoding so the taxon call is based on the actual classification evidence rather than an incomplete run record.
